source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 33.9 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Alcanadre (stage 9) on 2026-11-03, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-11-03. 10 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alcanadre (stage 9) 34, Calahorra (stage 10) 31, Alfaro (stage 11) 29, Gallur (stage 13) 28, Tudela (stage 12) 26, Alagón (stage 14) 24. FWI anomaly at Alcanadre is +9.6 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
